# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, angular woman without curves. Her dark hair, which shows gray streaks, is tightly twisted in a hard little knot at the back with two wire hairpins pushed aggressively through it. Over time, her face has softened, her eyes have grown gentler and milder, and her smile has become more frequent and tender.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002)_

## Personality

Marilla is a woman of narrow experience, rigid conscience, and firm practicality who rarely indulges in imaginative thinking. Though stern, reserved, and horribly afraid of displaying unseemly emotion, she possesses a deep capacity for love and a quiet sense of humor. Over the years of raising Anne, her disposition softens and mellows considerably, though she maintains her high standards of neatness and order.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015), [v1 c8 P17](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0017), [v1 c9 P50](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0050), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002)_

- Rigid conscience  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- Practical and matter-of-fact  <sub>[v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015), [v1 c8 P17](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0017)</sub>

## Abilities

- Impeccable housekeeping and cleaning  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise Anne properly and teach her Christian discipline  <sub>[v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029)</sub>
- To maintain Green Gables and keep her household in proper order  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert and her brother Matthew decide to adopt an orphan boy to help with farm work, but due to a misunderstanding, Anne Shirley is brought to Green Gables instead. Though initially determined to send the girl back, Marilla relents out of pity and a sense of duty, agreeing to raise her. Over time, despite frequent trials caused by Anne's impulsive nature and vivid imagination, Marilla grows deeply affectionate toward her. When Matthew dies suddenly, Marilla faces severe failing eyesight and considers selling Green Gables, but Anne decides to stay in Avonlea to help her keep the homestead. Later, Marilla takes in the orphaned twins Davy and Dora Keith, eventually receiving a trust fund for their care. After Anne departs for college, Marilla invites Mrs. Rachel Lynde to live with her at Green Gables for companionship and shared duties.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), [v1 c3 P52](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0052), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011), [v1 c38 P3](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0003), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c26 P28](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0028)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Green Gables in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Was told as a child by an aunt that she was a 'dark, homely little thing'  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Inherited an amethyst brooch passed down from her mother  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>
- Lived a narrow, single life at Green Gables with her brother Matthew  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)</sub>

## Quotes

> This is a real fine evening, isn’t it? Won’t you sit down? How are all your folks?  <sub>[v1 c1 P11](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0011)</sub>

> No; you’ll call me just plain Marilla. I’m not used to being called Miss Cuthbert and it would make me nervous.  <sub>[v1 c8 P9](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0009)</sub>
